properties.name: Indian Ocean (GOaS)
properties.source: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions, Global Oceans and Seas v1
properties.note: North of 60S; includes the Red Sea, the Persian Gulf and the Arabian Sea, excludes the Indonesian archipelagic seas (GOaS puts those in their own region). Interior rings dropped (land inside the region is excluded by sst_daily holding ocean cells only). Longitudes are continuous across the region, on the 0-360 frame where the region allows and as negative degrees east where it crosses the prime meridian.
